columns.spliceai_ds_fullprec: SpliceAI 1.3.1 max delta, full float precision (models/spliceai/score_fullprec.py)
columns.pangolin_fullprec: Pangolin git 5cf94b8 max(gain,|loss|), full float precision (models/pangolin/score_fullprec.py)
columns.nucleotide_transformer: NT-v2-500M-multi-species masked 6-mer LLR, 6,000-bp window, RunPod A6000 (models/nt/score.py)
columns.spliceai_ds_cli_rounded: the atlas's copy of the rounded CLI column (identical to frozen-matrix-v1 spliceai)
columns.pangolin_score_cli_rounded: the atlas's copy of the rounded CLI column (identical to frozen-matrix-v1 pangolin)

note: the sixteen RAD51C SNVs absent from the atlas are scored separately (data/rescore/*_frozen_only16.tsv)
